title: Nine Rows of Opening
subtitle: 影视与影院 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 影视与影院（文学艺术与体育·影视与戏剧）
meta: 主题语境：影视与影院（文学艺术与体育·影视与戏剧）　|　核心词汇：cinema　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cinema 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my mother was sent to open ① cinema she could not fill, and she said the opening was the whole of the lesson. The ② cinema, meaning the hall and not the film, was nine rows wide and was opened by whoever came last; cinema, she said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ cinema in that town had the same curtain, and the ④ cinema at the end, meaning the one the manager kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever opened properly. Cinema, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ cinema was the whole of the century, meaning the pictures it carried and not the hall. The ⑥ cinema, meaning the pictures and not any of that, is the only thing in a century that everybody watches and nobody questions; cinema, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a hall and pictures. She said the pictures are the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ cinema had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the curtain. The ⑧ cinema of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine rows and eleven years of opening; cinema, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cinema I remember is the one at the end, which was opened in 1974 and is still described as the largest in the county. A ⑩ cinema, my grandmother said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being opened; every cinema, she said, is pictures that have agreed to look like a hall. She said the pictures were the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 影院（指那座放映厅本身，与那部影片相对）
C. 固定搭配：open a cinema 开一家电影院
D. n. 影院（指镇上每一家）
E. n. 影院（指末尾那一家）
F. n. 电影（抽象：它承载的那些影像）
G. n. 那些影像（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The cinema, meaning the hall and not the film
cinema was the whole of the century
the cinema had become a number in a report
The cinema of the whole thing
A cinema, my grandmother said in 1979

answers.why: open a cinema 意为“开一家电影院”，1954 年母亲被派去开她坐不满的那家电影院。
cinema 意为“电影院”，指那座放映厅本身而不是那部影片，宽九排，由最后来的人开。
cinema 指镇上每一家影院，每一家都是同样的幕布。
cinema 指末尾那一家（经理留下的那一家），是唯一有人认真经营过的。
cinema 意为“电影”，抽象指它承载的那些影像，父亲说 cinema 就是那个世纪的全部。
cinema 为抽象用法，指那些影像本身，是一个世纪里人人都看、却没人质疑的东西。
cinema 意为“电影院”，到 1969 年这家 cinema 成了报告里的一个数字。
cinema 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九排座位和十一年的经营。
cinema 意为“电影院”，我记得的是末尾那一家，1974 年开张，至今仍被说成全县最大的。
cinema 为抽象总称，祖母说一家电影院是唯一会因为被认真经营而变好的东西。
